note: Identifiers only. Entrance actors are FieldAndDungeonEntranceEventRequestActor. adult and child are GameBancParam names, start is a StartPos name inside that param. ages lists the player ages that can use the actor, taken from the file name. cat is by source and destination map. broken lists every adult or child destination that does not resolve in StartPos, why is file_age (field for an age the file never serves), map_age (source map is only reachable by the other age) or live.
